media:group.media:title: Tissot x Damian Lillard
media:group.media:description:
Collaboration should take you somewhere you wouldn’t have gone alone.
That idea was at the heart of our work with Damian Lillard on the Tissot PRX Skeleton Damian Lillard Special Edition. Throughout the creative process, our approach to Swiss mechanical watchmaking met Damian’s personal vision, experiences and relationship with time.
Known as “Dame Time” on the court, Damian’s mindset is built around preparation, precision and purpose. Together, we explored how those values could translate into a mechanical timepiece that feels genuinely connected to his story.
The result is a PRX Skeleton filled with details shaped through that exchange. At its heart, a manual-winding skeleton movement reveals the architecture beneath the dial. Around it, personal references to Damian’s journey are integrated throughout the design: his signature on the transparent caseback, a second hand shaped after his monogram, and a milk-crate pattern on the rubber strap inspired by the makeshift basketball hoops of his childhood, recalling where his passion for the game first took shape.​
The experience goes one step further with a dedicated conversion system that transforms the timepiece into a pocket watch, offering a different way to experience the watch.
A collaboration built around the moments that define us, and everything it takes to get there.
#DameTimeIsOurTime

media:group.media:title: Unboxing the Tissot Supersport NBA Special Edition. Our kind of pre-season prep.
Tissot | Supersport NBA Special Edition
media:group.media:description:
Introducing a new NBA edition of the Supersport Chronograph, defined by a monochromatic grey aesthetic that combines modernity, sportiness and sobriety.
Presented in a sandblasted steel case with a matte finish, the watch draws inspiration from contemporary technical sportswear, translating its streamlined forms, functional character and monochromatic palette into a distinctive design on the wrist.​
References to basketball appear throughout the watch. White dashed markings echo the lines of a basketball court, while the date window takes inspiration from the shape of the key area beneath the basket.​ Encircling the dial, a dedicated 24-second tachymeter pays tribute to one of the sport's defining rules. At the centre, the NBA hand immediately catches the eye, bringing a distinctive signature to the display.
Turning the watch over reveals a special NBA caseback engraved with references to the Eastern and Western Conferences. ​
Powered by a Chrono Quartz G10 movement, the watch combines chronograph functionality with a visual language inspired by basketball.​

entry.title: Unboxing the Tissot PRX Quartz Chronograph. Yes, we know what’s inside. Let us have this moment.

media:group.media:title: Unboxing the Tissot PRX Quartz Chronograph. Yes, we know what’s inside. Let us have this moment.
TISSOT | PRX Quartz Chronograph
media:group.media:description:
The PRX takes on a new rhythm. With the Tissot PRX Quartz Chronograph, we’re exploring a new interpretation of the chronograph, this time powered by quartz and shaped around the familiar design language of the PRX.
Its 41 mm stainless-steel case features shaped pushers that integrate naturally into the streamlined profile of the watch. The vertically brushed dial is structured around circled counters, complemented by a date display at 4 o’clock and Super-LumiNova®-coated hands and indexes for clarity in changing light conditions. Powering these indications, is a quartz chronograph movement that delivers precise chronograph timing.
Available in three distinct dial executions, the PRX Quartz Chronograph explores different facets of its character. The silver dial, accented by yellow-gold-coloured indexes, creates a warmer visual balance. In black, nickeled indexes sharpen the contrast and enhance the definition of the chronograph counters. The blue version brings a deeper sense of dimension, with the vertically brushed finish creating reflections that evolve with every movement of the wrist.
A new expression of the PRX, with a character of its own.

entry.title: Unboxing the Tissot Désir Moonphase. No spoilers, just a very good reason to keep watching.

media:group.media:title: Unboxing the Tissot Désir Moonphase. No spoilers, just a very good reason to keep watching.
TISSOT | Désir Moonphase
media:group.media:description:
As the world looks to the sky for tonight’s solar eclipse, we unveil a new interpretation of the Tissot Désir, where the moon takes centre stage.
These timepieces captivate through a subtle interplay of light and texture, creating a magnetic allure that mirrors the singular poetry of the moon. This vision unfolds through six distinct expressions, each designed to adorn the wrist with refined radiance.
At the heart of the collection, two models capture the depth of the night sky. The moonphase complication appears at 5 o’clock, set against a deep blue dial punctuated by mineral inclusions.
Complementing the depth of blue, four additional interpretations bring a softer expression to the collection, defined by silky-textured dials in silver, golden beige, and red, alongside a bi-colour execution.
From the depth of blue to softer, luminous tones, each model brings a celestial dimension to the Désir collection.
